mcqs.question: Jal Jeevan Mission completed seven years on which date?
mcqs.explanation: Jal Jeevan Mission completed seven years on 15 August 2026, having been announced on 15 August 2019. December 2028 is the extended deadline for the mission, while 2026–27 to 2030–31 is the continuation period of PM-KISAN.

mcqs.question: For which period did the Union Cabinet approve the continuation of PM-KISAN, and what outlay was approved?
options: 2026–27 to 2030–31, with an outlay of ₹3.15 lakh crore
15 August 2019 to 15 August 2026, with an outlay of ₹4.47 lakh crore
2024 to December 2028, with an outlay of ₹6,000 crore
2026–27 to 2030–31, with an outlay of ₹4.47 lakh crore
mcqs.explanation: The Union Cabinet approved PM-KISAN’s continuation from 2026–27 to 2030–31 with an outlay of ₹3.15 lakh crore. ₹4.47 lakh crore refers to the amount already transferred, while December 2028 is associated with the extended Jal Jeevan Mission deadline.
